sources.title: Banaxi-Tech/muon-model-test · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This experimental base model uses the exact BananaMind 2 Nano architecture and tokenizer. It was trained from scratch with stock PyTorch Muon on the hidden matrices and AdamW on the tied embedding and normalization weights, using only streamed FineWeb-Edu data for 24,999,591,936 custom-tokenizer tokens.
